items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: And I brought the whole big band to play the opening of Roland Kirk in that place. And I’d never heard him play live

ctx.x: Yep. Roland Kirk. It was a jazz club, it was called The Fishnet. This guy just loved jazz. It only lasted a few years because not that many people were coming. And I brought the whole big band to play the opening of Roland Kirk in that place. And I’d never heard him play live, I mean I was like oy, yoy, yoy this is great oh my God and he’s playing all these saxophones you know. And the kids were going — because I said, “Well this is going to be a happening for you now,” I said, “you’ll probably never see this…
